node.statement: Negative-mass estimate: by def-stochastic, row-stochastic Q is entrywise nonnegative. For each row i and coordinate j with P_ij<0, (P_ij)_-=-P_ij<=|P_ij-Q_ij| since Q_ij>=0; summing over j gives the negative mass of row i at most ||p_i-q_i||_1. Taking the maximum over rows gives delta(P)<=||P-Q||_{inf->inf}<=12 eta.
